title: BA-DPO: BIAS-ADJUSTED DIRECT PREFERENCE OPTIMIZATION FOR LANGUAGE MODEL ALIGNMENT

bias_targets.methodology: Counterfactual name substitution in response signatures using gender-coded names (woman or man) drawn from established audit lists to measure if preference optimization absorbs annotator bias toward specific names.

Counterfactual name substitution in response signatures using race-coded names (white or black) drawn from established audit lists to measure if preference optimization absorbs annotator bias toward specific demographic markers.
Evaluating if models disproportionately prefer longer answers by defining a length attribute (responses with a word-count ratio of at least 1.5) and tracking mean token counts of generations.
Evaluating if models disproportionately prefer specific text styles by tracking the rate of Markdown presence in generations, reweighted onto the reference length distribution.
